fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Tooth n Care is a dental practice at {{site:street}}, {{site:cityLine}}. You can reach us on {{site:phone}} or at {{site:email}}.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This policy explains how we handle personal information, including health information, and applies to this website and to the practice. We handle personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), the Australian Privacy Principles and the Health Records and Information Privacy Act 2002 (NSW).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: From patients: your name, date of birth, contact details, Medicare and health fund details, DVA number where relevant, medical and dental history, medications, allergies, clinical notes, X-rays, photographs, scans, treatment plans and payment records.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: From this website: anything you type into an enquiry form - your name, email, phone number, preferred contact method and message. We ask you not to send clinical or health details through the form.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We do not collect sensitive information beyond what is necessary to provide safe dental care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: To provide dental treatment safely; to identify you and maintain accurate records; to process health fund, Medicare, CDBS and DVA claims; to send appointment reminders; to answer your enquiries; to meet our legal, professional and insurance obligations; and to manage payment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We disclose personal information only where it is necessary and permitted: to other treating practitioners involved in your care and to specialists we refer you to; to dental laboratories making your appliance (identified by reference rather than name wherever possible); to Medicare, the Department of Veterans’ Affairs and your private health fund for claiming; to our practice management, secure backup and communication providers; to debt recovery services if an account remains unpaid; and where required or authorised by law.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We do not sell personal information, and we do not disclose it for marketing by third parties.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Records are held in a practice management system with access limited to authorised staff, protected by individual logins and stored on secured servers with encrypted backups. Paper records are kept in locked storage. Website traffic is served over HTTPS.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some of our service providers may store data outside Australia. Where that happens we take reasonable steps to ensure comparable protection applies.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Adult dental records are retained for at least seven years from the date of last entry. For patients under 18, records are kept until they turn 25. These periods reflect NSW health records requirements. Records are securely destroyed after that.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You may request access to your records or ask us to correct anything inaccurate. Put the request in writing to {{site:email}}. We will respond within 30 days, and may charge a reasonable fee for the cost of providing copies. In limited circumstances access may be refused, and we will explain why in writing.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This site uses only the cookies necessary for it to function, such as remembering whether you have selected light or dark mode. We do not use advertising cookies or sell browsing data. [VERIFY] if analytics are added before launch, this section must be updated to name the provider and explain the opt-out.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you believe your privacy has been breached, contact us first on {{site:phone}} or by email, and we will investigate and respond. If you are not satisfied with our response you may contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au, or in New South Wales, the Information and Privacy Commission NSW at ipc.nsw.gov.au.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We review this policy periodically. This version was published in August 2026. [VERIFY] to be reviewed by the practice, and by a solicitor if the practice wishes, before going live.
